metadata.case_name: ANIL JHUREMALANI v. RODELIO O. FAJADA AND ANOTHER

plaintiff.occupation_before: estate agent in Hong Kong and in that city

source: the plaintiff has sustained a whiplash-type injury.
there was soft tissue damage in the way that one so often finds in these type of cases.
this is now a permanent condition.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified strain or sprain of cervical spine

manifestations.description: pain in the neck on rotation to the right
feeling of tiredness towards the end of the day
sleep at night is disturbed; "he has not had one night's undisturbed sleep since this all took place"
stiffness when he rises in the morning which tends to resolve after exercises

reduced ability to play tennis: "He used to play tennis three times a week... He is now restricted to playing tennis once a week, or sometimes once a fortnight, and he plays in the more modest C team."
reduced participation in Thai boxing (used to participate in the sport of Thai boxing)
weight gain: "As a result, he has put on weight and the pleasure of life has been affected by that."

treatments_received: alleviates that pain by taking painkillers as and when needed.
report by Dr Lee Po-chin dated 4 December 2001
report from Dr Morell at the Portuguese Clinic in Montreal dated 30 July 2001
fee note from the Canadian hospital (medical expenses)
treatments_future: no need for further medical or surgical treatment

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: He used to play tennis three times a week... He is now restricted to playing tennis once a week, or sometimes once a fortnight, and he plays in the more modest C team. He used to also participate in the sport of Thai boxing.
The plaintiff's social life has been affected... the pleasure of life has been affected by that.
